text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty 1342 triggered: high NotReady spike in eu-gpu-infer pool (alerts: kubelet_heartbeat_missing x12). Paging alice_oncall and sasha_infra

alice_oncall: seeing ~18% NotReady nodes in eu-gpu-infer, packets show kubelet restarts. Customers reporting increased tail latency.

sasha_infra: copying recent node state: `kubectl get nodes -l pool=eu-gpu-infer -o wide` shows 14/80 NotReady. Kernel dmesg on node eu-gpu-17 shows watchdog reset.

infra-bot: Auto-evac policy engaged for pool eu-gpu-infer: draining pods from nodes with kubelet_failure_score>0.7

emily_sre: on it, starting triage. Are we seeing CUDA or runtime OOMs as a cause or underlying host HW resets?

bob_runtime: logs from a crashed runtime pod show repeated allocator OOM and a CUDA error on startup: `E tensorflow/stream_executor/cuda/cuda_driver.cc:xxxx] failed: CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_FAILED` then container restart. Also some containers show `killed by OOM-Killer` in dmesg.

carlos_prod: customer impact: a couple of high-volume customers in EU are seeing 502 and 504s. Routing today should fallback to ded nodes but traffic surge prevented graceful failover. Need temporary routing cut to avoid customer timeouts.

dana_support: fielding customer messages, starting a status note draft. ETA for mitigation?

alice_oncall: immediate plan: 1) cordon the most flappy nodes 2) drain safe pods to buffer nodes in us/eu pooled capacity 3) scale up dedicated warm pool by +3 nodes 4) enable aggressive model-fallback policy for low-priority routes.

sasha_infra: running `kubectl cordon eu-gpu-17 eu-gpu-29 eu-gpu-42` now. Draining non-critical pods (batch prefetchers) first: `kubectl drain eu-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m`

alice_oncall: starting selective drain - keep live inference on nodes with current KV-cache hot. Avoid cold restarts for hot customers.

bob_runtime: adding logs snippet for one crash: ```
[2026-03-17T09:11:52Z] runtime: allocation failed, requested 3.6GiB, available 1.2GiB
[2026-03-17T09:11:53Z] ERROR cuda: failed kernel launch, status=CUDA_ERROR_LAUNCH_FAILED
[2026-03-17T09:11:53Z] containerd: container exited with code 137
```

emily_sre: kernel watchdog restarts look correlated with driver v520.61 on these nodes. Cross-checking node image version list. If driver crash, node will kubelet-restart and flip NotReady.

alice_oncall: can we temporarily route EU inference traffic to us-west and add a rate limit ramp to avoid overload?

sasha_infra: yes. Updating routing policy: set region_preference: eu->us with 0.6 weight shift. Executing traffic switch now (rc=apply-rt-17698).

infra-bot: rollout event: route-policy/rt-shift-17698 applied. Old weight eu:0.9 -> eu:0.3, us:0.1 -> us:0.7

carlos_prod: confirming with two customers that latency improved after traffic shift. Still seeing some dropped requests for users pinned to EU-only zones.

dana_support: posted initial status to status.redwood.ai: "Investigating NotReady nodes in EU GPU pool; partial traffic reroute in progress".

emily_sre: while routing shifts, I'm going to patch the node driver: rolling update of host-driver to v520.89 that includes watchdog fixes. Plan: cordon/upgrade/drain/reboot/uncordon in small batches of 2 nodes.

bob_runtime: recommending also temporarily lowering per-pod GPU memory limit to force lower allocations on hot start paths; will push a non-breaking config patch to the runtime: `--gpu-mem-limit=90%` -> `--gpu-mem-limit=80%` for candidates.

alice_oncall: go for the config change as a canary on a small subset (3 pods). If stable, propagate.

sasha_infra: started node patch on eu-gpu-05/eu-gpu-08. Drain successful, reboot queued.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: PagerDuty 1342 acknowledged by alice_oncall

dana_support: customers updated, asking for ETA. I'll say 30-45m for initial mitigation, will update as we progress.

bob_runtime: applied runtime config canary to service shard r-12, async: decreased OOM events in canary logs (3->0 in 10m). Looks promising.

emily_sre: eu-gpu-05 back online after driver patch and reboot. kubelet stable, node Ready. Releasing 2 more nodes for patch.

carlos_prod: traffic slowly rebalancing back to eu, monitoring. Noticing a backlog of queued requests for customers with pinned affinity; we'll continue fallback for now.

alice_oncall: next actions: finish driver roll, scale dedicated warm pool by +3 if OOMs reappear, create post-incident ticket for root cause analysis focusing on driver/kernel/watchdog interactions and runtime allocation patterns.

sasha_infra: taking handoff at +30m check-in if alice needs to step out.

emily_sre: will collect kernel + driver logs and attach to the ticket. Also schedule a repro with the runtime team using a stress profile.

dana_support: status updated to customers: "Traffic rerouted; partial recovery underway. Next update in 30 minutes or on major change."

alice_oncall: thanks team. Marking incident as "mitigated" once all nodes <5% NotReady and tail latency returns to baseline. Leaving thread open for final confirmation. :thumbsup:
